definitions.explanation: A publication issued separately from a main series, such as a special edition of a magazine or an appendix published as its own volume.

examples.japanese: {別冊|べっさつ}{付録|ふろく}が{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: It comes with a separate supplement.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}の{別冊|べっさつ}が{来月|らいげつ}{発売|はつばい}される。
examples.english: A special issue of this magazine will be released next month.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}レシピをまとめた{別冊|べっさつ}が{人気|にんき}{雑誌|ざっし}の{付録|ふろく}として{配布|はいふ}された。
examples.english: A separate volume compiling cooking recipes was distributed as a supplement to a popular magazine.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {別|べつ} (separate) + {冊|さつ} (volume, book). Used in publishing to refer to supplementary or special publications issued alongside a main series.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別冊|べっさつ}{付録|ふろく} (separate supplement)
- {別冊|べっさつ}○○ (Bessatsu + magazine name, e.g., {別冊|べっさつ}マーガレット)
- {別冊|べっさつ}を{出|だ}す (to publish a special issue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {増刊|ぞうかん}: extra issue — a special additional issue of a periodical
- {付録|ふろく}: appendix, supplement — an extra item bundled with a publication
